04 — OUR STORY

It started with a
simple observation.

A salon visit should feel easy. But the experience around it often isn't.
Customers call to ask about availability, wait for a response, adjust their plans, and sometimes spend more time coordinating an appointment than actually enjoying it.

On the other side, salon teams are constantly balancing bookings, schedules, customers, and the day's unexpected changes.

We wanted to make that experience simpler. So we started building a system where a customer can choose a service, find a suitable slot, and book their appointment without the back-and-forth — while salons get a clearer, more organized way to manage their day.

What began as an idea is now a growing product, shaped by real people and real salons. We're still refining, listening, and building with the belief that a better salon experience starts long before the chair.
